detail: primordial/soup/b2/graphworld.py (B2 toy) has no action channel (MOVE dir=(id*7+t*3+flee)%4 is fixed by SPEC), no observation vector and no fitness/charge. lut_top needs uint16 obs [D] and an action choice; corruption needs observations. Supplying them means authoring a new world and choosing its objective, not running the drawn cell. Applies to every representation x graphworld_b2.
